manual.scope: Affected memory, configuration and implementation-status pages; full-manual layout is not re-audited. An initially overflowing policy-name line was corrected and final pages rerendered.

limitations: The original missing admission is source-confirmed; no pre-fix hostile EL0 exhaustion is reproduced.
Serialized controls allocate actual nodes, but do not prove concurrent EL0 fairness, general kernel heap/principal admission, or allocator OOM handling under every context.
Current 64-byte layouts reach count ceilings before byte ceilings; actual native byte-ceiling exhaustion is not claimed.
Requested layouts exclude allocator overhead and independent nested allocations. Other object/borrower/namespace/account families remain separate.
Containing transfer/backing and broader IRQ/guard/destructor qualification remains open. Refund grants no backing/hardware completion, physical replay or new recovery custody.
No new formal/refinement result or historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping attribution.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen source hashes identify the complete changed code set.
